verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm that LM Studio serves an llms.txt at https://lmstudio.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with structured 'About LM Studio' content). They also confirm Markdown versions of its docs pages, such as /docs/app.md, which an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation advertising these agent-oriented resources, no evidence of how completely llms.txt covers the docs (e.g., an llms-full.txt), and no community corroboration of agents using them.
